profile.headline: Senior Web Developer at Clemson University

positions.title: Junior DevOps Engineer
positions.description: IT Team Lead for Direct Tools Factory Outlet e-commerce platform. Supported the integration of SAP Commerce Cloud with SAP ERP. Collaborated with development, business, and infrastructure teams to design and implement new features, expand on existing functionality, and triage production issues.

positions.title: Assistant Photographer
positions.description: Photographed Clemson sports events, organized and edited event photos, and managed social media galleries. I also organized and archived event photos for Clemson's personal photo libraries. Technologies I used: Adobe Photoshop and Adobe Lightroom.

positions.title: Digital Operations Intern
positions.description: I designed and implemented a website to display status information for Lowe's Digital services. Technologies I worked with included: HTML/CSS, Javascript, Node.js, jQuery, and JSON.

positions.title: Seasonal Employee
positions.description: Operated point of sale terminal for customer transactions. Assisted customer inquiries in-person and via phone at customer service desk.
